_note: The heart events (data/events/heart_<villager>.json): one short scene per villager when their heart band first reaches 3 and the farmer talks to them. One part per villager, started at its id. Our own scenes.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: Ah, it's you. Sit with me a minute? My knees and I have been arguing all morning.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: You know, I kept a little packet back every year. Eggplant seed, from the plants by my door.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: My hands are too slow for a whole row now. But a farmer who stops to talk to an old woman... you'd look after them.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: I'll give them the best corner of the field.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: Bring me the first one that ripens. That's all the thanks I want.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Hey... can you keep a secret? A real one, not a baby one.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: There's a big carp in the pond. Old and black, with one white spot. I've seen it three times and nobody believes me.

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: If you catch it, don't sell it. Just look at it and let it go. Promise?

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Pinky swear counts double. You're alright, you know that?

lines.speaker: kota
lines.text: Fine! Then I'll catch it first, and I won't even show you. ...Maybe I'll show you.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Oh, good. Could you hold this end of the ledger? The wind keeps turning the pages.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: My father kept this store for thirty years. Some days I think I'm only minding it until someone better comes.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Then a farmer walks in every week asking for seeds, and the shelves have to be full, and I forget to worry.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: So, thank you. For being a reason. I'll stop talking before I embarrass us both.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Wait. Let me see your hands.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Calluses in the right places now. When you came, you held a hoe like a broom.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: My teacher said a tool remembers who uses it well. I never believed him until I was old.

lines.speaker: hachiro
lines.text: Bring yours by whenever the edge goes. I'll look at them first. That's not for everyone.
